value.rationale: This is a complete natural exceptional-characteristic degeneration of the maximally line-rich classical Schur quartic equation: the surface becomes a nonnormal Frobenius scroll with conductor square, a positive-dimensional line family, and explicit zeta and line-count formulas. These separate a naive model from the known good model and clarify model-sensitive arithmetic geometry.
